correctness.rationale: Restrict the sketch Gram M=S^TS to U=span{b,Ab}, with 1−ε<=M<=1+ε. The spectral polynomial implies M²<=2M−(1−ε²)I. For ||b||=1, d=b^TMb, this yields ||Mb||/d<=1/sqrt(1−ε²). Writing A=αI+T, ||T||<=δ gives |h_S−α|<=δ/sqrt(1−ε²). Dimension-two A=diag(μ,L), M=[[1,−ε],[−ε,1]], B=(MA+AM)/2 give det(B−zM)=(1−ε²)(z−α)²−δ²; generalized eigenvectors attain both ends. Lower end equals zero at εcrit; explicit (μ,L,ε,b)=(1,9,4/5,(2,1)) yields h_S=−5/3, and at (1,9,3/5,(3,1)) yields zero. Independent symbolic rational pencil checks passed.
residual_risks: Only one-vector, real SPD matrices, exact arithmetic and subspace-embedding guarantee; no multivector, complex or approximation-error bound.
